summary.text: Brenda Lyttle is a Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2022 campaign for the same district that she lost in the general election.
